name: deprecation-cascade
title: Deprecation with downstream re-open
interface: CLI: node tools/deprecate.mjs <contract> --reason <text> [--dir <project>]. Appends to laws/deprecations.log and reports every dependent contract whose submissions import the deprecated one — the set that verification will now hold Open until re-pointed to a successor contract.
nl_description: OPEN. Requirements change is the one thing software has that mathematics does not: statements can become wrong. Contracts are never edited; they are deprecated, and the cascade re-opens dependents.
